query: Loading Z-Image Turbo with Qwen3-4B-2507 text encoder GGUF throws "gather(): Expected dtype int32 in index but got int64" in UnetLoaderGGUF.

desired.outcome: city96 confirmed the index should be int64 per PyTorch docs and pushed a fix converting index dtype in the GGUF loader; reporter confirmed the quick fix works.
